name: Dried fish
summary: Khô cá is dried fish, one of Châu Đốc’s traditional trades and a specialty sold beside the mắm. Buy it to take home, or taste dried cá sặc and cá lóc tossed through gỏi sầu đâu.
origin: Phường Châu Đốc, where drying fish is a traditional trade. Together with dried beef it makes up the gift known as khô Châu Đốc.
howToEat: Buy it at the market to carry home.
Dried cá sặc and dried cá lóc are the fish in gỏi sầu đâu.
where: Chợ Châu Đốc, beside the mắm stalls.
seoDescription: Khô cá is the dried river fish of Châu Đốc, a traditional trade sold beside the mắm at the market.
